eight_key_attribution_questions.1_treatment_primarily_fixed_field_names: Yes. On retry 1, Treatment corrected 'handle' -> 'question_handle' and 'type' -> 'action_type'.
eight_key_attribution_questions.2_primarily_fixed_enum_values: Yes. In addition to field names, Treatment strictly adhered to QuestionStatus enum values ('open'/'in_progress') and avoided 'completed'.
eight_key_attribution_questions.3_changed_action_intent: No. The action intent across both attempts was to integrate specialist findings for q-1; the structure changed from malformed to conformant.
eight_key_attribution_questions.4_changed_illegal_closure_to_legal_non_t: Yes. Any potential completion intent was converted to valid non-terminal update.
eight_key_attribution_questions.5_control_remaining_blocking_errors: Control repeated invalid to_status enums ('completed' or other unrecognized strings) and invalid union discriminator payloads, exhausting retries.
eight_key_attribution_questions.6_both_arms_received_identical_validatio: Yes. Both arms received standard Pydantic ValidationError payloads detailing loc and error type.
eight_key_attribution_questions.7_guidance_text_literally_provided_field: NO. The Guidance text explicitly explains status vocabulary, delegation vs question state machines, and closure rules. It does NOT literally contain the string 'question_handle'.
eight_key_attribution_questions.8_instructions_altered_epistemic_judgmen: Yes. Guidance reinforced that absence of evidence does not justify closure, preventing hallucinated basis handles.

rigorous_causal_boundary.mechanism_explanation: Guidance provided conceptual and contract boundaries (status enums, state machines) that enabled the model to correctly interpret Pydantic retry feedback without entering degenerative discriminator loops. However, n=4 on a single fixture cannot prove any individual sentence was the sole causal driver.
rigorous_causal_boundary.ungrounded_claim_rejected: Guidance 让模型正确修复字段名称与状态词汇 (in the literal sense of listing 'question_handle')
